title: A Song About the Sunrise
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: When Zacharias could talk again, the Holy Ghost filled him. He praised Heavenly Father with words like a happy song.
“Blessed be the Lord!” he said. “He is sending the Savior, just as the prophets promised long ago.”
Then he looked at his tiny baby. “And you, little child, will get people ready for the Lord. You will teach that sins can be forgiven.”
p2: All this comes from Heavenly Father’s tender mercy, His soft and gentle love. The sun comes up each morning and chases the dark away. Zacharias said Jesus would come like that sunrise, bringing light.
Jesus is gentle with us, like the morning sun. Tonight, use soft words with someone who feels sad.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
